title: 제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법 제363조제5항에 따른 범칙금 양정기준에 관한 규칙 / queue:ANNEX:0000:00:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 제주특별자치도 설치 및 국제자유도시 조성을 위한 특별법 제363조제5항에 따른 범칙금 양정기준에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ATTACHED TABLE ? Rules on Criteria for Assessing Administrative Fines under Article 363 (5) of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province and the Development of a Free International City

CRITERIA FOR ASSESSMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE FINES (Related to Article 2)

No. | Applicable Provision | Conduct Subject to Administrative Fine | Amount of Administrative Fine

1. Article 355 (1) 1 of the Act ? A person who, in violation of Article 158 (1) of the Act, transports a group of foreigners to another area within the Republic of Korea, or arranges such transportation, for profit. Amount: not less than 10,000,000 won and not more than 50,000,000 won.
2. Article 355 (1) 2 ? A person who, in violation of Article 158 (2), provides a ship, aircraft, other means of transportation or passports for the purpose of transporting a group of foreigners to another area within the Republic of Korea, for profit. Amount: not less than 10,000,000 won and not more than 50,000,000 won.
3. Article 355 (1) 3 ? A person who, in violation of Article 158 (3), collectively conceals or helps evade detection of foreigners who have moved or are moving to another area within the Republic of Korea, or provides ships, aircraft or other means of transportation for that purpose, for profit. Amount: not less than 10,000,000 won and not more than 50,000,000 won.
4. Article 355 (2) ? A person falling under any subparagraph of Article 355 (1) who acts without a profit-making purpose. Amount: not less than 3,000,000 won and not more than 30,000,000 won.
5. Article 355 (3) 1 ? A person who moves to another area within the Republic of Korea without obtaining permission to expand the permitted area of stay under Article 157 (1). Amount: not less than 2,000,000 won and not more than 20,000,000 won.
6. Article 355 (3) 2 ? A person who violates Article 158 but does not fall under Article 355 (1) or (2). Amount: not less than 2,000,000 won and not more than 20,000,000 won.
7. Article 355 (4) ? A person who violates Article 159. Amount: not less than 1,000,000 won and not more than 5,000,000 won.
8. Article 355 (5) ? A person who refuses a lawful request made in the performance of duties by an immigration control official or another authorized official to confirm whether permission to expand the permitted area of stay has been obtained under Article 157 (5). Amount: not less than 50,000 won and not more than 1,000,000 won.
9. Article 360 (1) ? A person who prepares or conspires to commit an offense under Article 355 (1) through (3), or who attempts such an offense. Amount: the same as the assessment amount for the principal offense.
10. Article 360 (2) ? A person who instigates or aids an offense under Article 355 (1) through (3). Amount: the same as the assessment amount for the principal offender.
11. Article 361 (Joint Penal Provisions) ? In addition to the person committing a violation of Article 355 in connection with the business of a corporation or individual, the corporation or individual where a representative, agent, employee or other worker of the corporation or individual committed the violation in connection with such business. Amount: the same as the assessment amount for the person committing the violation.

These eleven numbered rows reproduce every separately identified legal basis, conduct, minimum and maximum amount (including exact won currency units), and cross-referenced amount rule in the supplied Korean table. The original HWP/PDF graphic layout is not independently verified.
